topic: Someone receives flowers with no card attached
text: The sun had just dipped below the horizon when I found them, a vibrant splash of color on my doorstep, the kind that usually comes with a note, a whisper of words that explain the unexpected beauty. But there was nothing—just the silence of the evening air and the unspoken questions threading through my mind. I traced the petals, soft and inviting, wondering about the hands that placed them there, the thoughts behind the gesture. The room felt a little colder without the weight of an explanation, the warmth of a familiar signature. I arranged them carefully, the colors a stark contrast to the dim light of my home, hoping that somehow, they would speak the truths that words couldn’t.
